entry.title: Code for emergence of metastability
entry.content:
Check the dedicated GitHub repo here for all the code. If you are a Julia user, you can simply download the .jl file.

The latter can be viewed on any browser, and you can also run it via Binder. To do this, just follow the instructions in the introduction section. The notebook has many different buttons that will allow you to explore the system, so no need to know how to code to play around with the model! If you do want to check the function, all the functions can be found at the end of the script.

Otherwise, just scroll down to take a look at the whole code!

entry.title: Synergistic Motifs Tutorials
entry.content:
Here is a quick post with some easy links for the tutorials/walkthrough-code acoompanying the paper:
“Synergystic Motifs in Gaussian Systems”

I am working on a longer post, much longer than the paper itself… So for now, take a look at our preprint: ArXiv: Synergistic motifs in linear Gaussian systems and the walkthroughs below!

Here are the walkthrough Julia notebooks

Basically, tutorials on how to reproduce all the results, including intermediate steps, and much more extra stuff.

NOTE: these are just html file, so no need to do anything, just click on the links and take a look. If you want to play around with the notebooks, I will soon write a guide on how to do so. On Github, where you can find the same files, there are already some instructions but I will improve that in the near future.

  • Gaussian Results
  • Ising-like model
  • Stuart-Landau oscillators
  • Empirical data study

As well as the python notebooks:

  • Multivariate time series study
